properties.label_detail_en: Mecca a commercial centre on the caravan route, with profit from pilgrimage (GHA III ch.2 p.33); early converts fled to Ethiopia (p.35). Caliphal frontier with Nubia was a treaty (the bakt), not annexation (GHA III ch.3 pp.81–82). The caliphates' extent is not drawn: no limit in the cited pages. Open edges: no limit line in the source; not a border.
